map.算法：提升高度 H = L×sin(倾角°×π/180)；截面积 A = Q/(: Algorithm: lift height H = L times sin(incline degrees times pi / 180); cross-section A = Q / (3600 times rho times v) (m2); computed belt width = sqrt(A / 0.14) times 1000 (mm), round up to the standard width series 400 / 500 / 650 / 800 / 1000 / 1200 / 1400 / 1600 / 1800 / 2000; friction coefficient f = 0.025, drive efficiency eta = 0.85, additional factor 1.2; total power P = Q times (L times f + H) times 1.2 / (367 times eta) (kW); lift power = Q times H / 367; friction power = Q times L times f / 367.
map.例：Q=200t/h、L=100m、倾角 10°、ρ=1.0t/m³、v=1.6: Example: Q = 200 t/h, L = 100 m, incline 10 degrees, rho = 1.0 t/m3, v = 1.6 m/s gives H = 17.365 m, A = 0.03472 m2, computed width 498.01 mm, select 500 mm; total power 15.283 kW (lift 9.463 kW, friction 1.362 kW). If belt speed raised to 2.5 m/s gives A = 0.02222 m2, computed width 398.41 mm, select 400 mm, one grade down, but total power still 15.283 kW (power independent of belt speed). If incline raised to 18 degrees gives H = 30.902 m, total power 25.69 kW, lift-power share up to 65.1 percent.

map.367 是 ISO/DIN 输送带: 367 is the constant in the ISO/DIN belt-conveyor
map.常数（由 102×3.6 得来），把 t/h·m 的做功量折算为 kW。公式本身: (from 102 times 3.6), converting t/h times m of work into kW. The formula is a simplified model, not counting idler rotating resistance, plows and feed impact, so reserve 10 percent to 20 percent margin at selection.
